title: Battly Mobile 2.2.5 is now available
content:
Battly Mobile 2.2.5 is now available. This update improves support for the latest versions of Minecraft, mod audio, and the way Battly displays its new features in each language. 

**What's new:** 

- What's new is obtained from the API in the device language, with full translations for the 10 most used languages and fallback to English. 
- Battly retains the last valid response from the server and updates the cache only when the API content changes, so the new features remain available offline after they have been loaded once. 
- Improved support for **Minecraft 26.3**, including startup fixes, rendering and textures in Vanilla, Fabric and custom versions. 
- Added support for native library plugins used by mods such as **Distant Horizons**. If the compatible plugin is installed, Battly no longer blocks startup by detecting the mod. 
- Minecraft mods that use the microphone can now detect an audio input in Android. 
- Added selection between the internal microphone, headphones and other audio inputs available. 
- Improved microphone isolation in Battly Worlds to avoid sending the audio of the game itself to other players. 
- Fixed Vulkan issues, alternate surfaces, and orientation that could display the screen rotated or rendered incorrectly on some devices. 
- Fixed an issue where some control or client profiles could only reduce the rendered window of Minecraft when using combinations such as Shift+W or Shift+right-click, while the controls remained full-screen. 
- Custom JVM arguments correctly replace equivalent defaults, including code cache size. 
- Reduced false crash warnings when Minecraft ends successfully. 
- General stability, compatibility, and diagnostic improvements. 

Thank you all for continuing to submit reports and helping to improve Battly ❤️

@here & @everyone

title: Battly Mobile 2.2.4 is now available
content:
Battly Mobile 2.2.4 is now available. This update focuses mainly on improving stability during long sessions, reducing sudden FPS drops, and fixing various issues related to LWJGL, Java, and the closure of Minecraft.

**What's new:**

- Improved FPS and memory stability during long sessions.
- Reduced sudden crashes caused by native and graphics memory pressure.
- Adjusted initial memory usage of Java to leave more resources available for Android, renderers, and mods.
- Fixed issues when preparing LWJGL from multiple processes simultaneously.
- Better compatibility of **LWJGL 3.3.3, 3.4.1, and 3.4.2** with modern versions of Java and Minecraft.
- Fixed rotated or duplicated screens on some devices when using the alternative surface rendering system.
- Improved detection of mods that include desktop native libraries incompatible with Android.
- Custom JVM arguments now correctly override launcher or version equivalents, avoiding duplicate or incompatible values.
- Normal shutdowns of Minecraft should no longer generate crash reports due to recoverable errors from the narrator or other optional components.
- Improved diagnostics for memory, renderer, and processes to facilitate analysis of device-specific issues.
- The name **Battly Launcher** remains unchanged in all languages and is no longer translated literally.
- General improvements in stability, compatibility, and performance.

Thanks to everyone for continuing to send reports and help improve Battly ❤️

- New searchers, grid-organized versions, and indication of the recommended compatible version.
- Better version selection for mods, modpacks, shaders, resource packs, and datapacks.
- More compact overall design better adapted for devices with a notch.
- Internal improvements in Terracotta, connection, performance, stability, and translations.

Battly Mobile 2.2.0 makes it much easier to play with friends from anywhere and improves several of the most used parts of Battly Mobile.

title: Battly Mobile 2.1.0 is now available
content:
Battly Mobile 2.1.0 is already here with one of the biggest updates so far, focused on improving the gaming experience, instance management, downloads, performance, and stability.

**What's New:**

- New complete configuration system for PlayStation, Xbox, and Nintendo Switch controllers, with a guided assistant, animated 3D previews, motion mapping, camera, clicks, D-pad and scroll, stick calibration, and independent profiles for each instance.
- MobileGlues updated to version 2.0.0, with new graphics options, performance improvements, and greater compatibility with the latest versions of Minecraft.
- Completely renewed download system, with HTTP/2, connection reuse, download resumption, and up to 100 files simultaneously.
- The change in downloads represents a huge speed improvement: the latest snapshot of Minecraft, which previously took about 2 minutes to download, can now be ready in about 15 seconds.
- New in-game controller image, customizable and with buttons that respond in real time.
- At the end of an installation, you can open the modpack directly.
- Better detection of incompatible mods, with clearer explanations and solutions.
- Battly selects Java, LWJGL, and the most suitable renderer for each version of Minecraft more intelligently.
- New graphics options to better adapt performance to each device.
- Downloads now use 64 simultaneous connections by default, manually adjustable between 16 and 100.
- New maintenance center capable of automatically detecting and repairing different problems.
- Improved FPS counter and measurement of the server's real ping.
- Fixed the top buttons and the operation of the ESC key.
- Better response of touch controls within the menus.
- Internal improvements in the download system, content management, and compatibility.
- General improvements in stability, performance, compatibility, translations, and design.

Battly Mobile 2.1.0 represents a major change in many parts of the application, especially in the download system, which now makes much better use of the available connection and drastically reduces the time required to install new versions.

The goal of this update is to offer a much faster, fuller, more stable, and comfortable experience when playing Minecraft from Android.

Thank you all for continuing to use Battly and for sending your feedback ❤️

title: Battly Mobile 2.0.1 is now available!
content:
Battly Mobile 2.0.1 is now available with a host of new features, performance improvements, and fixes. 

**What's new:** 

- New Battly Skin Manager with upload, library, application and removal of skins, slim model and 3D preview. 
- Support for permanent custom skins on offline accounts. 
- New Battly Social to search for friends, manage requests, see who's playing, invite, and join. 
- New instance and world manager with duplication, import, export, backup, restore and diagnostics. 
- New Battly file manager with list and grid views. 
- New renderer system with better detection, Battly interface, and support for more graphical backends. 
- MobileGlues updated with improvements for Sodium, shaders, textures, and modern versions. 
- Improvements in Minecraft versions, including search engine, filters by type and more practical lists for Vanilla and loaders. 
- Improved support for Forge, NeoForge, Fabric, Quilt, LegacyFabric, OptiFine, and customers. 
- New ForgeOptiFine option to install Forge and OptiFine automatically. 
- Faster, parallel, resumable and device-adapted downloads. 
- Improved mod installation with automatic dependencies and fixes for CurseForge and Modrinth. 
- Better management of installed content to activate, deactivate, delete and move mods, resource packs, shaders and datapacks. 
- Improved controls marketplace with search, previews, likes, saved items, icons, and a new design. 
- New customizable FPS and ping counter for controls. 
- Independent controls and configurations for each instance. 
- Implementation of login with Battly, Google, and Discord. 
- Java 8 is now downloaded after the initial setup process to reduce the size of the app. 
- New Java manager with download, import, detection and repair of corrupted runtimes. 
- Better support for snapshots, LWJGL, Battly Client, shaders, Forge and old versions. 
- Better automatic selection of Java, LWJGL and renderer depending on version and device. 
- Better handling of unexpected closures: Battly returns to the launcher, analyzes the error and displays useful information. 
- Optimized news with cache, languages, images, and links. 
- Performance and memory improvements for less powerful devices. 
- More screens, dialogs, menus, and confirmations tailored to Battly's design. 
- New translations, revised texts and corrections in all available languages.
- Important fixes in dependencies, horizontal orientation, renderers, skins, runtimes, and elements of the old interface.  

Thank you all. Enjoy Battly Mobile 2.0.1! ❤️
